added_models.model: hDMD transgenic mouse carrying the full human DMD locus (local IM injection of the human-sequence exon 51 PMO)

engagement.population: DMD mutations amenable to single-exon skipping (exon 44, 45, 51 or 53)
engagement.note: Exon 51 PMOs injected into hDMD mouse muscle; the chosen PMO (AVI-4658) skipped human exon 51. No patient data yet.
engagement.quote: Eight specific AO sequences targeting exon 51 were tested in two different chemical forms and in three different preclinical models
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level (PubMed 17767400); the 22.1% skipping figure for eteplirsen in hDMD gastrocnemius is from FDA's 2016 pharmacology review summary of this paper.
engagement.judgement: Opening entry: a separate in-vivo system from patient cells, the only animal carrying the member drug's own target sequence.

engagement.population: DMD mutations amenable to single-exon skipping (exon 44, 45, 51 or 53)
engagement.note: Intramuscular AVI-4658 in boys' EDB muscle restored dystrophin locally, as local hDMD-mouse injection had predicted.
engagement.short: Local IM dosing reproduced in boys
engagement.quote: Intramuscular AVI-4658 was safe and induced the expression of dystrophin locally within treated muscles.
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level (PubMed 19713152). Paired by me; Kinali reports dystrophin, the hDMD study reported exon 51 skipping; FDA PharmR 2016 notes skipping in patients' EDB too.
engagement.judgement: Paired: same route (local IM), same molecule, same readout family (exon 51 skipping and dystrophin); hDMD skipping 22.1% vs patients' 22-32% dystrophin intensity has no matched dose, so direction only.
engagement.magnitude_basis: exon 51 skipping (hDMD) vs dystrophin expression (patients) after local IM injection

added_models.model: Cynomolgus monkey dosed IV/SC with eteplirsen, exon 51 skipping read by PCR (12-week GLP study 4658-GLP-0901)

engagement.population: DMD mutations amenable to single-exon skipping (exon 44, 45, 51 or 53)
engagement.note: Monkey 12-week GLP study (4658-GLP-0901) measured eteplirsen exon 51 skipping in muscle and heart; conserved sequence; results unpublished until the 2016 review.
engagement.quote: The sponsor assessed exon skipping in only one study, a 12-week toxicity study in monkey, which demonstrated low levels (<1%) of exon 51 skipping at the low and mid IV doses
engagement.confidence_note: First-use year is a proxy from the sponsor study number (GLP-0901); the study date itself is not stated in the review text found.
engagement.judgement: Opening entry: monkeys carry the human exon 51 target sequence for eteplirsen, so this is a product-in-model engagement readout.

engagement.population: DMD mutations amenable to single-exon skipping (exon 44, 45, 51 or 53)
engagement.note: FDA set monkey dose-dependent exon 51 skipping beside the dose response in patients' muscle (Study 33): skipping at 0.9 mg, not 0.09 mg.
engagement.short: FDA: monkey dose response matched patients
engagement.quote: Of note, a similar dose response was observed in DMD patients in exploratory Study 33 (see Clinical/Statistical-Efficacy), in which direct intramuscular injection of eteplirsen led to increased skipping of exon 51
engagement.confidence_note: Verbatim in bundled 206488 MedR. Monkeys were dosed IV/SC (5-320 mg/kg), patients by IM injection, so routes differ; monkey skipping was <1% at low/mid doses and 4.5-8.2% at 320 mg/kg.
engagement.judgement: Source itself puts the two side by side (comparison_stated true). Direction only: route and dose scales differ.
engagement.magnitude_basis: presence of a dose-dependent rise in exon 51 skipping

added_models.model: Each patient's own skin fibroblasts treated with AVI-4658 ex vivo (response used to select who was dosed)

engagement.population: DMD mutations amenable to single-exon skipping (exon 44, 45, 51 or 53)
engagement.note: Kinali's trial enrolled only boys whose cultured fibroblasts responded to AVI-4658, a patient-level responder screen.
engagement.quote: Seven patients with Duchenne muscular dystrophy with deletions in the open reading frame of DMD that are responsive to exon 51 skipping were selected on the basis of the preservation of their extensor digitorum brevis (EDB) muscle seen on MRI and the response of cultured fibroblasts
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level; the fibroblast assay (presumably MyoD-converted) and its per-patient readout were not verified in full text (Europe PMC full text did not return).
engagement.judgement: Opening entry: a patient-derived ex-vivo assay used to choose who gets treated, distinct from the class-level sequence-selection cells in the draft.

engagement.population: DMD mutations amenable to single-exon skipping (exon 44, 45, 51 or 53)
engagement.note: Every fibroblast-selected boy given 0.9 mg showed new dystrophin in the injected muscle; no fibroblast-negative boy was dosed, so discrimination is untested.
engagement.short: Selected boys all responded at 0.9 mg
engagement.quote: Intramuscular injection of the higher-dose of AVI-4658 resulted in increased dystrophin expression in all treated EDB muscles, although the results of the immunostaining of EDB-treated muscle for dystrophin were not uniform.
engagement.confidence_note: Abstract-level (PubMed 19713152). n=5 at 0.9 mg; the 0.09 mg boys did not respond, a dose effect not a screen failure.
engagement.reason: Selected responders responded; none excluded tested
engagement.judgement: Same paper reports the screen and the outcome, but no per-patient comparison and no screen-negative arm, so partial agreement; registry results posted 2019, after the 2009 paper.
engagement.magnitude_basis: responder status (fibroblast exon 51 skipping vs dystrophin in injected EDB)
